summary.text: Dave Robertson is a Democratic state representative from the 19th Middlesex District who has served in the Massachusetts House of Representatives since January 2019 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is vice chair of the House Committee on Ethics.

paragraphs.text: Dave Robertson took office on January 2, 2019.
Besides the House Committee on Ethics, he serves on the Joint Committees on Election Laws, Public Service, and Telecommunications, Utilities and Energy.
